question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom/phrase.

Throw in the towel

options.text: To cause an activity or process to continue
To take responsibility for a situation while another person is temporarily absent

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Throw in the towel"** means to give up or surrender, especially after a struggle or when facing defeat. (हार मान लेना)

 
 
• **Example:** After failing the exam multiple times, he decided to throw in the towel and pursue a different career path.
 
 
 
• **"Surrender"** refers to the act of yielding or giving up in a situation, especially when facing overwhelming opposition. (आत्मसमर्पण करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The soldiers had to surrender when they were surrounded by the enemy troops.
 
 
 
• Hence, the idiom "Throw in the towel" aligns with the concept of giving up or surrendering.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: To prepare to fight** (लड़ाई के लिए तैयारी करना): This means gearing up or getting ready for a confrontation or challenge.

 
 
• **Example:** The boxer started preparing to fight as he entered the ring.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: To cause an activity or process to continue** (किसी गतिविधि या प्रक्रिया को जारी रखना): This means ensuring that something progresses or does not stop.
 
 
• **Example:** He worked tirelessly to cause the project to continue despite the challenges.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: To take responsibility for a situation while another person is temporarily absent** (किसी व्यक्ति के अनुपस्थित होने पर स्थिति की जिम्मेदारी लेना): This refers to stepping in to manage something temporarily in someone else's absence.
 
 
• **Example:** She agreed to take responsibility for the team while the manager was on leave.
